## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)
*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*
Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 81 (titled *Dubbala*, "Criticizing a robe distribution") belongs to the *Pācittiya* section of the Theravāda Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga [SuttaCentral]. The rule addresses monks who call into question communal decisions regarding robes: if a monk who is part of a complete, formally assembled Order (*saṅgha*) gives away a robe to an appointed official of the Order, but subsequently criticizes or objects to that transaction, he incurs an offense requiring confession (*pācittiya*) [SuttaCentral]. A modern English translation of the text has been made by Bhikkhu Brahmali [SuttaCentral]. Secondary literature search hits for this rule in fact discuss the separate rules of the Bhikkhunī Pātimokkha rather than the monk's Vibhaṅga text.
The disciplinary requirement is widely attested across early Buddhist Vinaya lineages [SuttaCentral]. Within the Pali tradition, direct internal parallels are found in the Bhikkhu Pātimokkha (Pācittiya 81), the Bhikkhu Parivāra, and corresponding provisions for nuns in the Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga (Pācittiya 159), Bhikkhunī Pātimokkha, and Bhikkhunī Parivāra [SuttaCentral]. Curated parallels cataloged by SuttaCentral include Bhikṣu and Bhikṣuṇī Vibhaṅgas and Prātimokṣas of the Sarvāstivāda, Mūlasarvāstivāda, Mahīśāsaka, Mahāsaṅghika, Dharmaguptaka, and Kāśyapīya recensions preserved in Chinese, Sanskrit, and Tibetan [SuttaCentral]. Text-reuse analysis by DharmaNexus shows extensive phraseological sharing with over 100 other Pali texts, particularly highlighting common procedural and word-analysis formulas shared with Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga Pācittiyas 13, 21, 79, and 82, the *Samathakkhandhaka* (Kd 14), and sub-commentarial texts such as the *Vinayavinicchayaṭīkā* [DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus also aligns segments of this text with Tibetan Vinaya commentaries, including the *Pratimokṣasūtraṭīkā Vinayasamuccaya* and the *Āryasarvāstivādimūlabhikṣuṇīpratimokṣasūtravṛtti* [DharmaNexus].
